context.body: The retelling preserves confession, warning, presumption, defeat, and prolonged stay at Kadesh.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The people admit sin, arm themselves, and treat ascent as easy after the sentence.
observations.label: Deuteronomy retells the presumptuous ascent: action

observations.body: The LORD tells Moses to warn them not to go because he is not among them; they refuse, ascend presumptuously, and the Amorites chase them.
observations.label: Deuteronomy retells the presumptuous ascent: response

observations.body: we have sinned · armed · do not go up · rebelled · Amorites chased
observations.label: Words in Deuteronomy 1:41–46

payload.posture: Read Deuteronomy 1:41–46 as presumption and later retelling evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Numbers names Amalekites and Canaanites as attackers; Deuteronomy names Amorites without explaining the difference.
payload.title: Deuteronomy retells the presumptuous ascent
